policy: The complete maximum-range nine-load request, including native MPBR, zeroing, event analysis, drag diagnostics, response serialization, and process startup, should complete within 2.5 seconds at p95 on supported CI runners. Keep the cancellable per-request process while measured process-startup and serialization overhead remains below 250 ms. Reconsider a persistent NDJSON worker after two representative release baselines exceed that overhead threshold.
